text:
kevin: pushed a small prototype: quota-aware cost preview card. shows current per-route cost and a simulated column that applies quota spillover rules (if tenant hits quota, X% traffic moves to dedicated pool -> different unit_cost). preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/dash/quota-spill

anya: neat. how deterministic is the simulation? finance will want to understand assumptions for the spillover math.

kevin: simulation uses routing policy weights + a configurable spill matrix. default spill matrix: primary->dedicated: 100% when quota exceeded. You can tweak percent in the UI.

pradeep: what about cache savings when traffic spills? dedicated pool shares a different cache; prefetch hits won't necessarily carry over. do we simulate that?

kevin: yes, we model cache delta: we estimate cache_loss = baseline_kv_hits * (1 - cross_pool_cache_affinity). affinity is a param (0-1). we expose the param in the API and in the UI tooltip.

billing-bot: deploy 6123456780-quota-spill -> staging succeeded (10s)

anya: sampling/provenance: the preview is simulated, but if someone exports CSV we need provenance per row so bookkeeping can trace assumptions.

kevin: export CSV includes columns: route, tokens, gross_cost, simulated_spill_cost, provenance, sample_rate, schema_v. provenance is a short pipe-delimited string: sampled|aggregate|simulated_spill.

pradeep: per-model economics: ensure we attach `sku` and `variant` and include unit_cost_delta when moving to fallback sku (e.g., quantized -> fp16). otherwise the numbers confuse PMs.

kevin: done. dashboard shows sku, variant, unit_cost_before, unit_cost_after, and unit_cost_delta.

anya: UX: add a tiny inline "what-if" slider that lets you change %spilled and see delta in-place. also a sparkline for token variance.

kevin: slider added in staging. sparkline too.

samir: performance note: the simulated spill runs per-request when the slider changes. keep heavy work in the browser or microbatch precompute for common spill values.

kevin: implemented cheap client-side computation for delta using pre-fetched per-route aggregates. heavy recompute flagged and routed to a small job if someone requests full trace-level simulation.

pradeep: reconciliation: include a flat `explain_inputs` field in CSV (k=v pairs) listing routing_weights, affinity, sample_rate so auditors can replay.

kevin: will add explain_inputs and increment schema_v on any changes. also adding runbook note about negative simulated cache credits (eviction race) and how to interpret them.

anya: schedule a 20m with finance + infra to validate the default affinity and spill matrix tomorrow. I'll invite.

kevin: thanks — will keep the feature flag `quota_spill_preview_v1` off in prod until signoff. :thumbsup:
